text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: This is a non-review research paper focused explicitly on land use and land cover (LULC) prediction for continental Portugal, i.e., a national-scale spatial implementation covering the entire country. The primary objective is LULC prediction/simulation using Markov chains combined with cellular automata. The study implements multiple future scenarios (business-as-usual plus three alternative scenarios) with quantitative comparison of land cover proportions. Spatial modeling is performed with quantitative accuracy metrics reported (quantity and allocation disagreement measures). Outputs include spatially explicit mapped LULC projections for 2040. The study also analyzes results at the NUTS 2 regional level within Portugal. Thus, all core inclusion criteria are met, and none of the exclusion criteria apply.)
